subject: Hybrid Data Guardrail: bundle terms, amortization, and evidence delivery
messages:
From: Lisa Nguyen <lisa@medforge.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@medforge.com; Aaron Patel <aaron.patel@medforge.com>
Date: Sat, 1 May 2027 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Hybrid bundle pricing questions

Hi Vivek —

Thanks for the call yesterday. We like the idea of a single ‘Guardrail’ bundle (audit logs + KMS/HSM seat + residency + HIPAA add-on) but procurement needs a clear cost treatment before we can move to PO. A few asks from our side: 

1) Can you show a 3-year cost table that separates one-time implementation (evidence/prep/SOW) from recurring charges?
2) We need to understand whether the HSM seat is pass-through (3rd-party) or a Redwood-managed SKU and how you amortize that in the invoice.
3) For audit logs: is retention configurable per-environment and priced per-GB or as a flat slab?
4) Evidence delivery cadence — we need weekly artifact delivery during onboarding (SOC checklist, attestation artifacts). Can you commit to a schedule?

Also, our security team asked whether the HIPAA package triggers any additional egress / network design fees. We don’t expect a high volume but want clarity.

Appreciate a short table and a proposed invoice mapping we can share with Finance.

Best,
Lisa
Director, Vendor Procurement
MedForge Health

Attachment: medforge_sow_request.pdf (PDF, 48KB)
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
To: Lisa Nguyen <lisa@medforge.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 1 May 2027 13:08:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Hybrid bundle pricing questions

Lisa —

Thanks, great notes. Looping in Ben (pricing/finance) and Laura (solutions/onboarding) to give you the breakdown you asked for. High level up front:

- We can offer a blended 3-year economic with a one-time onboarding SOW (implementation + evidence delivery) and a recurring monthly charge for the bundle.
- HSM seat can be sold two ways: (A) Redwood-managed billed as a monthly SKU (we amortize internally), or (B) pass-through to the hardware vendor with a direct line item. For MedForge we recommend Redwood-managed to simplify ops and provide consolidated support.
- Audit log retention is configurable by tier. Pricing options: per-GB tiered slabs for ingest/retention or a fixed retention band for predictable billing.
- HIPAA add-on is a recurring surcharge (per region) — no additional egress fees beyond standard transfer pricing unless you request dedicated cross-connects for on-prem integrations.

Ben/Laura — can you prepare: 1) 3-year table (one-time vs recurring) 2) a recommended HSM billing mapping with amortization example 3) an evidence delivery schedule (weekly deliverables during the 8-week onboarding window).

Vivek
VP, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference

---
Attachment: redwood_security-bundle-1pager.pdf (PDF, 120KB)
From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
To: Lisa Nguyen <lisa@medforge.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 2 May 2027 09:22:00 -07:00
Subject: FW: Hybrid bundle pricing questions — cost table and amortization

Lisa / MedForge team —

Attached is a worked example (tabular) for a 3-year commitment. Summary here:

- One-time onboarding SOW: $85,000 (project PM, evidence collation, SOC checklist, environment hardening) — invoiced at contract signature, milestone-based.
- Recurring bundle: $28,500 / month (includes audit log tier up to 10TB/mo retention, Redwood-managed HSM seat, HIPAA surcharge).
- HSM accounting: we amortize the managed HSM seat over 36 months in the invoice if you prefer blended monthly pricing. For visibility we can surface the hardware depreciation as a separate card on the invoice; the net Billed AR stays the same.
- Discounting: for a 3-year commit we can offer a 12% commit discount on recurring charges or a $22k credit applied to the onboarding SOW (your choice).

I attached the Excel schedule that maps invoice lines to milestones (implementation kickoff, evidence sign-off, go-live).

If you want a strictly pass-through seat, recurring drops by ~6% but you’ll receive a vendor invoice for the HSM vendor and we won’t be able to consolidate support into Redwood SLAs.

Ben
Head of Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachment: evidence_delivery_calendar.xlsx (XLSX, 16KB)
From: Aaron Patel <aaron.patel@medforge.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
Cc: Lisa Nguyen <lisa@medforge.com>
Date: Mon, 2 May 2027 11:40:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Hybrid bundle pricing questions — cost table and amortization

Thanks — couple quick clarifications from my side: 

1) We prefer the discount applied to recurring charges (keeps onboarding budgeted separately). Can you show the post-discount monthly and total TCV?
2) For audit logs: can retention be split per-environment (prod 90d, staging 30d) within the same contract and priced proportionally?
3) Evidence cadence looks fine but procurement needs a guaranteed delivery date for the SOC attestation artifact (we must file with internal auditors). Can you commit to a delivery date no later than week 6?

Also — one operational ask: will Redwood provide a one-page artifact mapping (evidence -> deliverable name -> owner -> date) we can attach to our internal approval packet?

Aaron
Senior Security Engineer
MedForge Health
From: Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
To: Aaron Patel <aaron.patel@medforge.com>, Lisa Nguyen <lisa@medforge.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 2 May 2027 14:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Hybrid bundle pricing questions — cost table and amortization

Aaron / Lisa —

We can do everything you requested. Quick confirmations: 

- Post-discount recurring: $25,080 / month (12% off $28,500) — TCV over 36 months = $902,880. One-time SOW ($85k) remains separate unless you want us to apply the alternative $22k credit to SOW.
- Audit log retention: yes — we support per-environment retention bands in the same contract. We’ll itemize prod/staging ingest and storage in the invoice mapping.
- SOC attestation: target delivery Week 6 from kickoff (we commit to no later than Day 42).
- One-page evidence index: attached — maps deliverable -> owner -> expected delivery date and the artifact filename.

Next steps: if you confirm the discount applied to recurring and Week 6 SOC delivery we’ll issue a redline and an invoice mapping for signatures.

Laura Bennett
Director, Solutions Onboarding
Redwood Inference

Attachment: evidence_index_1pg.pdf (PDF, 14KB)
From: Lisa Nguyen <lisa@medforge.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 2 May 2027 16:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Hybrid bundle pricing questions — cost table and amortization

Vivek/Ben/Laura —

This aligns with what Finance and Security need. We confirm: apply the 12% discount to recurring charges (post-discount monthly $25,080) and keep the $85k SOW as a separate one-time invoice. Please send the redline and the invoice mapping and we’ll route for PO today. SOC attestation by Day 42 is required.

Also please include the evidence_index_1pg.pdf in the DocuSign packet (procurement requires a deliverable index).

Thanks —
Lisa
